Direct servo case (24.7 x 35 x 45.2 mm, centred at 0, 27, -340 mm in the upper leg) against the front cannon tube (radius 7.5 mm): gap 2.0 to 2.0 mm through the range, all of it lateral (the case is outboard of the tube's plane).

Not checked by the model: the servo's output-axis offset along its case (not entered): the model centres the case on the carpus axis; a real STS3250's output shaft is off-centre, which moves the case's lowest point by up to that offset; the lateral stack: horn, any bearing or adapter between the case and the cannon, and the cannon's own fitting at the joint; the model places the case 2 mm outboard of the upper-leg tube by a fixed constant; the case against the other front leg, the chest block and the springs (no spring on the carpus of this body); contact with the ground in the simulator: the case and the pulleys are visual geoms, so a play never feels them.
